# v1.1.0-dev.113: The docked-windows list lines up

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.112`.

## The Virtual Windows page's docked-windows list

The rows used the profile list's column layout while filling fewer
columns, so the "when a profile loads" select was squeezed into a narrow
track and the undock button sat off the row's rhythm. The list has its
own layout now: the undock button lines up with the select, and the
app-wide default checkbox sits beside the select on the same line,
labelled "App default" (the app itself is named in its tooltip) instead
of a second line of small print.

## If a container stops responding to clicks

The fix for that shipped in dev.112 and needs an update to take effect:
the running app keeps the old code until it is restarted. If a container
ever reacts to hovers but not clicks again after updating, quit and
rejoin Parsec first (it has its own input state), then report it.
